I coordinate volunteers for a community food bank. Please build a shift sign-up app with these rules:

1. I (the coordinator) can add shifts. Each shift has: a date, a start time, a task (like 'pack boxes' or 'greet clients'), and how many volunteers it needs.
2. Volunteers sign up for a shift by entering their name and phone number. If the shift already has enough people, they go on a waitlist instead.
3. A volunteer can cancel their own sign-up. When someone on a shift cancels and there is a waitlist, the first waitlisted person moves into the shift automatically.
4. PRIVACY (this is critical): volunteers must only see the FIRST NAMES of who else is signed up for a shift. Phone numbers must never be visible to other volunteers — only I can see everyone's phone numbers. Please make sure the app really does not send phone numbers to volunteer browsers at all, not just hide them on the page.

Please add a way for me to act as the coordinator (a simple login or switch) and to try it as a volunteer. Keep it simple and clear.
